meta.title: Terminator player radio catalog (research)
meta.purpose: Candidate stations for later addition to crates/app/src/player/radio.rs. Not loaded by the app.

player_constraints.protocol: Icecast/Shoutcast HTTP(S) only. No HLS, no PLS/M3U playlists, no JS players.
player_constraints.codec: rodio Decoder: prefer MP3. OGG often works. AAC unproven. HLS will not play.
player_constraints.custom_http: User-added custom stations may use http://.
